review_reason: Historical water class: self-crossing component lobes, principally the component near 6.86E/9.82N, have ambiguous signed area. MakeValid polygonises their intended positive lobes. Raster-era value comparison is not applicable to this historical picture product.

Gulf of Guinea: one self-crossing exterior ring forms an oppositely wound eastern marine lobe (about 1,868 km2). Invalid signed-area evaluation subtracts that lobe; MakeValid includes both marine lobes. The roughly two-lobe area increase is expected and all bounds remain unchanged.

Precambrian basement polygon: MakeValid separates one vertical, zero-area LineString from the valid polygon. The line alone extends 0.006091117859 degrees north of the polygon. Dropping that collapsed line shrinks the feature envelope but changes no polygon coordinate or polygon area.

Cross River National Park: five overlapping/nested input components are resolved to two valid polygons. Repaired area 3,294.375 km2 is closer to the independently stored WDPA area 3,318.661 km2 than the invalid signed-area result 3,462.900 km2; no coordinates are translated.
